_about: HCKIT3 v93: THE one build-identity / build-chain config. Read by Assets/Editor/BuildCfg.cs + BuildPlayer.cs + HdrpBatch.cs + JoanSwap.cs (path Tools/build_config.json, relative to the project root = Unity batch cwd) and by every Tools/*.ps1 through Tools/lib/hckit3_common.ps1. Dev/release options and the scene list stay in Assets/Data/build.json (that file ships in the player, this one does not). Dom 2026-11-05: exe name stays HadesSlice for now (no exe/icon/splash change yet): to rename the exe change build.exeName HERE ONLY. productName/companyName also move Application.persistentDataPath (saves, rebinds, finisher_rotation.json, Player.log) from LocalLow/DefaultCompany/HadesSlice to LocalLow/<companyName>/<productName>.

io._about: LOCKFIX v103: Assets/Editor/SafeIO.cs settings (retry of Win32 1224 'user-mapped section open' and other lock errors on Editor build-time writes). Missing = these defaults.

chain.name: Production
chain._flags: HdrpBatch.Production steps. Defaults = what HdrpBatch.V51 does today (true) plus the steps V51 skips (false). Turn a step on/off here, not in code.

swap._about: JoanSwap clone template (roster id). Today 'Dracula' (the scene object whose component set is cloned). Dom: no Dracula ENEMY, but the template object stays in the scene until a neutral template exists. Precedence: -swapTemplate:<id> on the Unity command line, then this value, then joan_swap.json templateId (legacy).
